question: Which book by Anirudh Kanisetti, exploring the history of Southern India, was awarded the Yuva Puraskar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lords of the Deccan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **Lords of the Deccan: Southern India from the Chalukyas to the Cholas** is authored by **Anirudh Kanisetti** and was released in the year **2022**.
 
• It was honored with the prestigious **Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar** in the **English** language category for the year **2023**.
 
• The book provides a vivid and comprehensive narrative of **Medieval South Indian history**, specifically focusing on the **Deccan** plateau and its powerful dynasties like the **Chalukyas**, **Rashtrakutas**, and early **Cholas**.
 
• The work covers a period of approximately **five centuries**, starting from the **6th Century CE**, and highlights how these empires shaped the cultural and political landscape of the **Indian subcontinent**.
 
• It aims to challenge the **North-centric** view of **Indian history** by bringing the complex geopolitics and achievements of **Southern India** to the forefront of mainstream historical discourse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India After Gandhi:** This is a critically acclaimed historical non-fiction book written by the noted historian **Ramachandra Guha**, first published in **2007**, which details the history of **India** after it gained independence from **British rule** in **1947**. *Hence, statement A is incorrect.*
 
• **The Anarchy: The Relentless Rise of the East India Company:** Authored by **William Dalrymple** and published in **2019**, this book explores the history of how the **British East India Company** seized control of vast tracts of **India** between **1756** and **1803**. *Hence, statement B is incorrect.*
 
• **Lords of the Deccan:** This work by **Anirudh Kanisetti** is the correct book that explores **Southern Indian** history and won the **Yuva Puraskar** in **2023**. *Hence, statement C is correct.*
 
• **The Argumentative Indian:** Published in **2005**, this is a collection of essays written by the **Nobel Prize** winning economist **Amartya Sen**, which focuses on **India's** intellectual history and its tradition of public debate and intellectual pluralism. *Hence, statement D is incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar** was instituted in the year **2011** to recognize and promote young Indian authors who are **35 years** of age or younger.
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi**, India's **National Academy of Letters**, was established on **12 March 1954** and functions as an autonomous organization under the **Ministry of Culture**.
 
• The award for the **Yuva Puraskar** consists of a casket containing an engraved **copper plaque** and a cash prize of **Rs. 50,000**.
 
• **Anirudh Kanisetti** is also known for his popular history podcast, **Echoes of India**, which brings ancient **Indian history** to a modern digital audience.
 
• The book **Lords of the Deccan** was published by **Juggernaut Books** and has been praised for its cinematic storytelling style and rigorous academic research.
